Gold / Silver: Gen II Gym scripts evaluate total badge count; at the six-badge state Goldenrod Rocket presence is armed before the full Radio Tower occupation.

Integration decision: Use a fact-driven transition, not a Pryce-specific trigger. Preserve the GSC six-badge pre-stage and map it to the HGSS midgame-complete fact when running the integrated story.

Gold / Silver: At the later badge-count stage, RadioTowerRocketsScript enables the tower occupation and weird broadcast.
Crystal: Crystal retains the same standard takeover script architecture.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Town/state scripts advance VAR_SCENE_ROCKET_TAKEOVER and activate FLAG_ROCKET_TAKEOVER_ACTIVE, including Elm's phone cue.
Integration decision: Create one TAKEOVER_ACTIVE fact consumed by Goldenrod City, Radio Tower and Underground maps; source-specific trigger details remain logged separately.

Gold / Silver: A special phone call / strange broadcast announces that something is wrong in Goldenrod.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS explicitly calls Professor Elm while advancing the takeover state.
Integration decision: Keep both the radio-world-state cue and Elm's direct notification; do not make either the sole hard gate.

Gold / Silver: Rocket NPCs/civilian visibility changes throughout Goldenrod during the occupation.

Gold / Silver: Not applicable.

Gold / Silver: No story uniform acquisition.

Gold / Silver: Not applicable.

Gold / Silver: Reception, Radio Card quiz, Lucky Number Show and civilians coexist with takeover states.

Integration decision: Preserve all pre-existing 1F systems; occupation only changes availability/dialogue/visibility through flags.

Gold / Silver: Rocket trainers occupy the floor during the event.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS retains floor NPCs and Rocket occupation data.
Integration decision: Crystal's Buena system is not sacrificed for HGSS story fidelity. Use occupation-conditioned dialogue/state only.

Gold / Silver: Multiple grunt battles remain part of the tower climb.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS rebuilds the trainer placements within its tower map.
Integration decision: Preserve the complete GSC trainer set in data; HGSS placements are an expanded-layout layer, not a representative replacement.

Integration decision: Use one CARD_KEY_SHUTTER_OPEN fact and keep source-specific map animation/block data.

Gold / Silver: Grunts/scientist are fought before the fake Director phase.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS retains the first-pass 3F ascent and later Card Key return.
Integration decision: Keep the two-pass tower topology: first ascent to fake Director, underground detour, then Card Key ascent.

Gold / Silver: Contains grunts/scientist and an unnamed male Executive encounter.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS names a 4F executive battle as Proton.
Integration decision: Keep the GSC anonymous Executive trainer/dialogue record and add Proton as the named HGSS commander; if both are encountered, legacy placement is an explicitly project-authored relocation.

Gold / Silver: The apparent Director is an unnamed male Executive (EXECUTIVEM_3).
HeartGold / SoulSilver: The fake Director visibly reveals himself as Petrel and battles as TRAINER_EXECUTIVE_PETREL_PETREL.
Integration decision: Retain EXECUTIVEM_3 as legacy data/event, then add the complete Petrel reveal. Do not merely rename the old trainer record.

Gold / Silver: Defeating the fake Director grants BASEMENT_KEY and redirects the player to the Underground Warehouse.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Petrel grants ITEM_BASEMENT_KEY after defeat.
Integration decision: One shared Basement Key entitlement; obtain/retry logic must be safe if inventory constraints differ between engines.

Gold / Silver: Absent.

Integration decision: Backport this event as HGSS-only narrative content, but keep it separate from the later five-Kimono-Girl / mascot ritual state machine.

Gold / Silver: Basement Key opens access to the Rocket-controlled switch-room/warehouse route.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS uses its tunnel lower-floor route under takeover state 4.
Integration decision: One story entitlement feeds either preserved GSC or HGSS-expanded underground layout.

Gold / Silver: Rival confronts the player in the switch-room route; team varies with starter.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS retains a rival battle in Goldenrod Tunnel B2F with starter-dependent Silver trainer IDs.
Integration decision: One shared story beat with source-specific trainer rosters. Do not duplicate the rival battle in one playthrough.

Gold / Silver: Absent.

Gold / Silver: Switch-room and warehouse include multiple Rocket and Burglar battles.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS rebuilds the lower tunnel with takeover-specific actors.
Integration decision: Retain all legacy battle records even where the remake changes layout or encounter ordering.

Gold / Silver: The real Director is held in the Underground Warehouse.

Integration decision: One shared DIRECTOR_RESCUED story fact, independent of map-layout implementation.

Gold / Silver: Director gives CARD_KEY and tells the player to open the 3F shutters.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: D37R0105 gives ITEM_CARD_KEY if not already owned.

Integration decision: Persist a global CARD_KEY_SHUTTER_OPEN fact; map rendering derives from it after reload.

Gold / Silver: Card Key route exposes the remaining Executive/boss path.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS second ascent leads through named commanders toward the Observation Deck.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS 5F zone data places TRAINER_EXECUTIVE_ARIANA_ARIANA.
